question: For what purpose should Jyeṣṭhā be worshipped on the previously mentioned seat?
premises: Worship is to be performed on the previously mentioned seat.
The goddess Jyeṣṭhā is the object of worship.
The purpose is the averting of enemies.
inference: One should worship Jyeṣṭhā on the previously mentioned seat for the purpose of averting enemies.
plain_english: One should worship Jyeṣṭhā on the previously mentioned seat for the averting of enemies.
